entries.notes: Added the frame's KPI strip (total / enabled / kill-switches / per-tenant, counted from the loaded flags) over the existing flags Work Queue — table (key · scope · kind · value · kill-switch state) + right detail panel + the §6/D10 confirm-by-typing kill-switch CeremonyModal. All real (GET /platform/feature-flags). Honest gaps: no separate count endpoint, so KPIs reflect the loaded page; the frame's per-row enable TOGGLES aren't replicated as a generic write (only the step-up-gated kill-switch is a real write path) — the kill-switch ceremony is kept instead.
Role-home launcher reconciled to Lantern (Fraunces headline, No-Line tiles on warm paper). Role-curated dashboard widgets (My Patients, AR snapshot, cosign queue) await their modules.

Rebuilt to the frame's 3-pane meeting view: a meeting header (status + packets-ready + Live surface) over a packet list | the selected patient's review packet | a right rail (attendance/quorum + schedule). REAL: meeting lifecycle/schedule, the packet-readiness list + freeze state, packets-ready count. Honest gaps: the packets read carries patient + freeze state, NOT the packet content (as-presented summary / eligibility / recommendations live on the full packet, /packets/:patientId) — so the center is a section scaffold + Open full packet; and attendance/quorum isn't on these reads (it's on the live meeting surface), so that rail is an honest placeholder.

Rebuilt to the frame's Patient Workspace: banner | HOPE timepoint rail (real patient HOPE timeline) | the timepoint's section list + clinical-context snapshot | a right rail (validation & triggers + iQIES submission), over a sticky footer (submission guard + actions). REAL: timepoint rail, status/target/author/signed metadata, J2051 max-severity + SFV trigger, the D8 PPS/ESAS-r snapshot, and the validation findings. Honest gap: per-section completion isn't exposed (section data is opaque server-side except Section J/J2051), so the section list shows J2051 real and the rest 'completion not exposed —', never fabricated completeness. NB the frame maps to hope.assessment-detail (the section view), not the patient HOPE timeline.

Rebuilt to the frame's MAR Grid: Patient Workspace (banner + module rail) | the Medication Administration Record grid (rows = medication orders, columns = dose times, cells = the dose's §2.2 status, selectable) + a recent-administrations strip | a right 'Administer' rail (five-rights scaffold). REAL: scheduled-dose grid + administration history + late-entry/controlled/RN-review pills, and — since the eMAR write waves — the administration WRITE paths: 'Record administration' opens the real AdministerModal (single-dose / PRN / hold, witness attestation, IV segments, send-to-prescriber) over the server's §2.9 gates and step-up. This note used to call that button an inert scaffold; it is not. Honest gap that remains: dose rows carry the medication ORDER id, not the drug/dose text the frame shows (no fabricated drug name).

Rebuilt to the frame's Patient Workspace: banner + module rail | orders table (kind · priority · status · live 48h verbal countdown, row-select) | right rail with the selected order's detail + Open order. All real (M11 order lifecycle data + CountdownChip on the real verbal deadline). Honest gap: the list carries the order KIND, not the clinical order text (drug/dose) the frame shows — that lives on /orders/:id — so rows label by kind, never a fabricated drug name.

Rebuilt to the frame's Patient Workspace: banner | visit-note document (note title + status, a vitals strip, a SUBJECTIVE/OBJECTIVE/ASSESSMENT/PLAN scaffold) | right rail (Sign-off + EVV/visit), over a sticky footer (cosign guard + actions). REAL: header (type/discipline/date/status/late-entry/version), cosignature state, signed/cosigned timestamps, patient banner, the four sign/cosign ceremonies (/sign, /cosignature/acknowledge, /cosignature/sign, /cosignature/supervisor-release — TASK-031, real step-up + 412/403 handling), and — since #92 — the vitals strip, bound to the real GET /encounters/:id/vitals (newest set, per-cell units, abnormal tone from the server's own flags; an em dash now means 'nobody recorded it', not 'the API can't say'). The note body is BOUND: since #114 the persisted HearthNote selections are read back assembled (GET /encounters/:id/selections) and the screen shows the assembled Layer-1 note — authored in the composer ('Compose note' / 'Edit note'), which replaced a single free-text box that could not satisfy the §2.6 Layer-3 gate — never a fabricated note. Vitals, mileage and care-plan links have their own save paths. Honest gap that remains: the EVV/visit join (M17/M18) isn't on the DTO. This note used to say Sign-note and the note body were unbuilt — they are not, and an external audit repeated that back as a release blocker (#107).

Rebuilt to the frame's Patient Workspace: banner | scale list | selected scale's score + capture history | a right-rail score trend. REAL throughout (scales, per-capture total scores + interpretation, captured-at/by, cosign-needed, SUD/redacted, the trend bars computed from the real score series). Honest substitution — the timeline exposes each capture's TOTAL score, not the per-item breakdown the frame's symptom bars show, so the center shows the score + history rather than fabricating per-symptom values.

Rebuilt to the frame's Patient Workspace: patient banner + module nav rail | a document-style 'Interdisciplinary care plan' card (every problem with its goals + interventions inline) | a right rail (IDG review + AI suggestion), over a sticky footer (IDG-quorum guard + actions). REAL: problems/goals/interventions, version+signers, patient banner. Honest substitutions — AI suggestion is a placeholder (M29 Clinical Copilot not built, no fabricated suggestion); no next-review date in the API (CoP note + signers shown instead); footer uses the real nav actions (Version history / summary / open draft) rather than the frame's unbuilt Save-draft / Submit-for-IDG write paths.

Banner (avatar + Fraunces name + DOB·age meta + MRN/status chips + Message action), icon nav rail, and Summary card composition + right Alerts/Tasks rail all match the frame. The care-plan (problems) and admission/election (benefit-period) cards are bound to the real M7/M6 reads (usePatientChartData). A card whose module has no patient surface yet renders an honest empty note rather than fabricated content.

Rebuilt to the frame's 'Card Sign in': gold hearth mark + Fraunces 'WardenX' lockup, Sign in title + subtitle, filled fields, full-width pill button, and a 'Forgot password? · Use a passkey' links row. Fully real — email/password + passkey both go through Better Auth; no placeholders.

Rebuilt to the frame's 'Card Two-factor verification' (same a1dbhD frame as Sign in): branded card, Fraunces title + subtitle, a segmented 6-digit mono OTP input (auto-advance + paste), full-width pill Verify. Fully real (TOTP + backup code via Better Auth). The frame's 'Resend code' link — which implies SMS/email OTP — is replaced by the functional backup-code toggle (our 2FA is authenticator/TOTP, which has no resend).

Rebuilt to the frame: Fraunces title, Notifications/Tasks/Mentions pill tabs + an inline stats strip, and a §6.2 No-Line card of rows (severity glyph + summary + source chip + status pill + relative time). The Notifications tab is the REAL alert inbox (GET /api/v1/alerts/inbox) with live Unread/Urgent/Failed stats; Tasks & Mentions are honest placeholders (Tasks/worklist module).

Rebuilt to the frame's Conversation View: a 'Messages' list (avatar + title + scope + unread dot, active row indigo-tinted) | a thread of chat bubbles (mine right/indigo via the real session user id, others left/paper) under a patient-scoped chip header, over a rounded composer. All real M36 data; the list's last-message preview/time isn't exposed by the channels read yet, so the secondary line shows the channel's real scope instead.

All 7 chromeless states (404/403/500/offline/maintenance/session-expired/suspended) render the System Page pattern matched to the frame: a circular tonal icon badge holding a Lantern inline-SVG Glyph (replacing the old emoji — §10.10), Fraunces headline, muted explanation, forward action, mono correlation id. CenteredStatusLayout enhanced to draw the badge.

Rebuilt to the frame's centered results column: per-scope No-Line cards with avatar + name + meta + status + chevron rows that navigate to the record. Patient + staff scopes are REAL (RLS/caseload + member.manage scoped); documents/orders/visits/commands are honest 'available when <module> ships' rows.

Header (title + Admit action), KPI strip, work table, and right detail panel match the frame. Census KPI is the REAL active count (GET /patients/census-metrics); Admissions/Discharges/GIP/Recerts KPIs are honest '—' placeholders noting their owning module (M6 / billing).

Built as a stepper workflow (Reason -> Details -> Effective date -> Review -> Confirm) in the patient workspace on the 2026-09-25 redesign kit; not yet matched region-by-region to the frame. All writes are REAL (POST /admissions/:id/discharge | /revocation | /transfer-out). The rail's current benefit period is best-effort from election-certification. Transfer-out records whether the receiving hospice cares for the patient at home or in a facility (claim patient status 50/51), and a for-cause filing links to the cosign screen (admission.discharge-cosign, same workspace frame). Death is its own workflow (admission.death-pronouncement).

Built as a stepper workflow (Record death -> Review & sign -> Post-death cascade) in the same patient workspace frame as admission.discharge (chart banner, step navigator, flat sections, right rail); not yet matched region-by-region to the frame. The write is REAL (POST /admissions/:id/discharge, reason death) with the pronouncing physician and the place of death (claim patient status 40/41/42). Honest gaps: the frame's family-notification and body-release steps have no backing route, so they are stated as cascade, not drawn as fillable steps.
